author: Composer
method: Per-style bands from per-ref values: n>=6 -> p10/p50/p90 widened by 10% of span; 3<=n<6 -> min/max widened 25%, low confidence; n<3 -> pooled ALL-ref p10/p90 plus the style refs, low confidence. ESTIMATE = Composer genre knowledge, not measured. Judged from MIDI + light audio features only (no listening).

conventions.grid: 16th slots 1-16 per bar; kick on 1/5/9/13; e/a = even slots; and = 3/7/11/15
conventions.intervals: voicings are semitone sets above the stab chord root

privacy: Abstracted statistics only, no reference names or note data; per JOB_GENRE_BRAIN.md ship this under data/genre/ with neutral names (strip "inputs").

npb_sd.desc: per-bar density SD (must vary bar to bar)

bass_sounding_frac.desc: fraction of bar time bass sounds

m1.desc: 1-bar repetition (bar n vs n+1 slot match)

bass.slot_weight_rule: slot weight = class weight x bar-position factor (slot 1 x0.8 because kick; slots 15/16 x1.2 in bars 4/8 for answers/pickups)

register_midi.source: GR v2 hard rule register 20-45; target ESTIMATE

scales.source: mode weights ESTIMATE informed by key_est (minor in 8/11 refs) and MIDI bass degree histograms

hard.rule: bass+stab out-of-scale time <= 5% for the chosen mode; tonic in the bass top-2 pitch classes; b2 time <= 12% and only as <= 1-sixteenth neighbour unless mode=Phrygian

bass on-kick <= 35% (HARD; soft target per style band); bass MIDI register 20-45; no bass note sustained across a kick hit at > -6 dB without duck (duck band -26.6..-3.6 dB); sounding <= 0.975 with >= 1 silent 16th per bar
every bar has >= 1 bass note unless a planned mute event; <= 12 bass notes/bar; no stuck/overlapping notes; no empty stab lane for > 8 bars in the main section; kick 4x4 coverage >= 0.8
skeleton similarity to every reference < 0.55 (FLAG >= 0.40); voicing+rhythm match < 0.75; within a batch of 20 rolls near-pairs (>= 0.40) <= 19/190; no ref note data stored in the repo
hard.src: GR v2 hard rule 4 + originality_check.py thresholds

soft.rule: per-bar bass density sd >= 0.5 and range >= 2 notes (refs sd 0.72-1.56)
bar 4 answers bar 2 with P=0.85: change >= 3 of the last 8 slots AND density by >= 1 note (not pitch-only)
bar 8 drawn from the turnaround palette; pickup into bar 1 must occur in >= 15% of rolls
stab hits in bass gaps target 2.1% (band 0.0-39.0); refs do NOT support a 40% floor
draw voicings from this style's weighted table; >= 2 voicings per 8 bars
hat 16th swing 51.2-57.5% (target 53.7); swing per lane, not global
weight rhythm cells by novelty within a batch; no seed period aliasing (no repeat of skeleton every 6 seeds)

avoid: root on slots 2 and 4 in more than 4 of 8 bars (stock figure)
>80% of bass attacks on e/a with no on-beat or "and" anchor (PR20 failure: 86%)
sustained b2 bass (>12% time) under stabs containing a natural 2
the same 4-bar cell 4x with only a pitch change at bar 4 (density must move too)
